theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_pw_proj_integral_estimate
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m l : ℕ) (pL : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid m) (S F : Set (Euclid P)) (K : Set (Euclid m)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P l), MeasurableSet F → F ⊆ S → IsCompact (S ∩ pL ⁻¹' K) → (∀ K' : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K' → μ K' < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) l, |ξ x β| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm β) → (∀ γ : Covector (Euclid m) l, covectorEuclideanNorm (γ.compContinuousLinearMap pL) ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm γ) → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid m) l) (M : ℝ), Continuous ω → (∀ y, y ∉ K → ω y = 0) → (∀ y, ‖ω y‖ ≤ M) → Integrable (fun x => ξ x ((ω (pL x)).compContinuousLinearMap pL)) (μ.restrict F) ∧ |∫ x in F, ξ x ((ω (pL x)).compContinuousLinearMap pL) ∂μ| ≤ c * M
